# Test images: credits and licences

Road-state test images for `services/vision`: 10 of the 12 are from Mumbai (Wikimedia Commons), 2 are generic (a flooded UK underpass and a broken-down London bus). Each is an at most 1024 px rendition of a file on Wikimedia Commons. **We pixelated every visible face and legible number plate** (boxes in `labels.json`, script `prepare_fixtures.py`); otherwise the images are unchanged. No person is the subject of any image: each shows a road and its vehicles.

The originals are the work of the authors below, under the licences named. The modified versions here are shared under the same licences (CC BY-SA files stay CC BY-SA). Marks or text visible in the photos belong to their owners.
